### How Fabio Uses CVD as a Leading Indicator
Valentini considers CVD a leading indicator because it tracks the intent and
outcome: aggression of market participants in real-time [3, 4]. While price action shows the *result* of a battle, CVD shows the *effort* being applied by aggressive buyers and sellers [4, 5].
